text.p: Sprint Corp said Monday it was awarded a three-year, $180 million contract with the Securities Industry Association (SIA).

Sprint said it was selected as the favored provider of communications for the SIA and its more than 760 SIA member firms. Sprint, the communications provider to the SIA for the past six years, said it was selected from a competitive field of communications providers, and will provide the SIA's member firms with a full range of long distance voice and data networking services.

Sprint said it also will collaborate with the SIA's Technology Management Committee to identify business solutions, including new technologies, that might assist SIA members operating in the time-critical environment of the securities markets.

"SIA member firms will now have access to volume discounts on every one of Sprint's core products, as well as the flexibility to incorporate any and all future offerings," Margery Tippen, vice president, channel management, Sprint Business, said in a statement.
